title: Bigger Plans

transformation_metadata.kind: macro / giantess size growth (curvy, sexy — NOT muscle)
transformation_metadata.subject: luna

scale_tiers.1: Baseline. Normal adult height (~1.7m). Standing comfortably in the loft.
scale_tiers.2: Slightly larger — clothes start to feel snug, she rises a head taller than Ethan.
scale_tiers.3: Noticeably big — ~2.5m, has to tilt head under the rafters, couch looks small under her.
scale_tiers.4: Towering — ~3.5m, fills a third of the room, furniture is doll-sized beside her.
scale_tiers.5: Huge — ~5m, head near the ceiling beams, has to kneel/hunch, Ethan is knee-height.
scale_tiers.6: Enormous — room-filling giantess, the loft is cramped around her, Ethan is shin-to-ankle height. Maximum, sexy and triumphant.

transformation_metadata.monotonicity: Once Luna reaches a size tier she never shrinks below it. Each panel >= previous panel's tier.
transformation_metadata.flavor: Confident, playful, sexy. Growth is fun and showing-off, not painful. Curves grow proportionally — fuller bust, hips, thighs — hourglass figure maintained. NO muscle growth, NO red/inflamed skin.

cast.name: Luna
cast.wardrobe: Sexy goth: black velvet/leather corset minidress with lace-up front, choker with a small silver pentacle, fishnet sleeves, chunky platform boots, black-painted nails. As she grows the dress stretches and strains at the seams — laces pull tight, hemline rides up — but always fully covers her (L4). Boots laces creak.
cast.appearance: Adult woman, 25. Pale porcelain skin, long jet-black hair with deep-purple streaks, blunt straight bangs. Smoky dark eye makeup, black lipstick, sharp winged eyeliner. Hourglass figure, full curves. When using magic her eyes glow faint violet and purple sparks/energy curl around her hands and body. Confident, mischievous, alluring expressions.
cast.prominence: PRIMARY — she is the focus of the comic. Most panels feature her solo or with her dominating the frame.

cast.name: Ethan
cast.wardrobe: Casual shy-guy: slightly oversized grey hoodie over a plain tee, dark jeans, white sneakers. Round wire-frame glasses.
cast.appearance: Adult man, 25. Slim, a little gangly, soft features, short tidy brown hair, light stubble. Perpetually nervous — flushed red cheeks that get redder through the comic, wide eyes, fidgety hands. Always looks small next to Luna.
cast.prominence: SECONDARY — appears smaller and off to the side; never dominates a panel. Reaction-shot fodder. Several panels omit him entirely (Luna solo).

locations.name: Luna's Gothic Loft
locations.description: A cozy but spacious top-floor loft apartment decorated goth-chic. Deep plum and charcoal walls, a tufted dark-burgundy velvet couch, a worn Persian rug, tall arched window with sheer black curtains and city dusk light. Dozens of dripping candles in iron holders, a few potted dead roses, an antique bookshelf of occult tomes, a pentagram tapestry, string of warm fairy lights. Exposed wooden ceiling beams overhead (these matter — they become the height marker as Luna grows). Simple, uncluttered DAZ3D-style interior: clean geometry, soft warm key light + cool violet rim light, shallow depth of field.
locations.daz3d_bg_note: Background should read like a rendered DAZ3D Iray interior set — simple modeled furniture, soft global illumination, gentle bloom on candle flames, slightly empty/clean staging. We will source a DAZ3D interior reference from the web (environment-references.md trick) and build a NEW original room in Flow off it, not copy it.

props.note: Dripping black/red candles, warm flames — consistent across panels.
Burgundy tufted couch — shrinks visually as Luna grows (scale anchor).
Exposed wooden rafters — the height gag marker as she gets huge.
Violet/purple sparks and curling energy around Luna's hands and body during growth.

lettering.bubble_style: Classic black-and-white 2D comic balloons: clean white rounded ovals, bold 3-4px solid black outline, ALL-CAPS bold black comic display font (Bangers-style), short triangular black-outlined tail to the speaker's mouth. Flat 2D overlay only — NO 3D shading, NO drop shadow on the scene. Bodies/room stay photoreal DAZ3D.
lettering.note: Every panel with dialogue bakes the bubble in at render time per L19.

panels.camera: wide-establish, three-quarter, eye-level, slight 3q on the doorway
panels.costume_state: Luna: corset minidress fully intact, neatly laced, fully clothed. Ethan: grey hoodie intact, fully clothed.
panels.action: Luna holds the loft door open with a warm, sly smile, beckoning Ethan inside. Ethan hovers on the threshold, shoulders hunched, clutching the strap of his bag, cheeks pink. The candlelit gothic loft glows behind her. Both at normal height. She is clearly the confident host; he is the timid guest. Luna dominant in frame, Ethan smaller near the doorframe.
panels.luna_face: Eyes half-lidded and warm, one brow arched, lips closed in a knowing crooked smile, head tilted invitingly.
panels.ethan_face: Eyes wide behind glasses, brows raised, mouth a small nervous line, cheeks flushed pink.

dialogue.speaker: luna
dialogue.text: COME IN, DON'T BE SHY... I'VE BEEN DYING TO SHOW YOU SOMETHING.

panels.notes: Cold open. Both baseline tier 1. Establishes the loft (candles, beams, couch) and the dynamic.

panels.camera: mcu, high-angle, gentle look-down on the couch two-shot
panels.costume_state: Luna: corset minidress fully intact, fully clothed. Ethan: grey hoodie intact, fully clothed.
panels.action: On the burgundy velvet couch. Luna lounges sideways, relaxed and sultry, an arm draped along the backrest, leaning toward Ethan. Ethan sits stiffly on the far edge, knees together, hands clamped on his thighs, leaning slightly away. Candles flicker. Luna takes up more of the couch and the frame.
panels.luna_face: Eyes steady and direct on Ethan, full relaxed smile, head level, faintly mischievous.
panels.ethan_face: Eyes darting sideways, brows up, lips pressed, a bead of sweat, cheeks redder.

dialogue.speaker: luna
dialogue.text: RELAX. IT'S JUST A LITTLE... PARTY TRICK. NOT EVERYONE GETS TO SEE IT.

dialogue.speaker: ethan
dialogue.text: OKAY BUT THE LAST 'TRICK' SET MY EYEBROWS ON FIRE.

panels.notes: Comfort beat. Still tier 1. Comedy: he's been burned before (literally).

panels.camera: ecu-region, eye-level, close on Luna's raised hand and face, shallow DOF
panels.costume_state: Luna: corset minidress fully intact, fully clothed.
panels.action: SOLO LUNA. She lifts one hand, fingers splayed, and violet sparks crackle to life curling between her black-painted nails. Her eyes begin to glow faint purple. A smug, delighted grin. Candle glow + magic glow on her face. No Ethan in frame.
panels.luna_face: Eyes glowing violet, narrowed in playful confidence, one corner of mouth raised higher than the other, brow cocked.

dialogue.speaker: luna
dialogue.text: WATCH CLOSELY, CUTIE. THINGS ARE ABOUT TO GET... BIG.

panels.notes: SOLO WOMAN focus. Magic ignites. Pun setup for the growth. Tier still 1 (no size change yet).

panels.camera: mcu, low-angle-front, tight on Luna's torso and face as she rises
panels.costume_state: Luna: corset minidress snug, faint seam tension starting, fully covering. Ethan: grey hoodie intact, fully clothed.
panels.action: Growth begins. Luna rises off the couch as her whole body swells a size larger — now a head taller, her corset dress pulling snug, curves fuller, purple energy rippling over her skin. She arches with a pleased gasp. Ethan, much smaller in the corner of the frame, recoils on the couch, going red, pointing weakly. Luna dominates ~70% of the frame.
panels.luna_face: Head tipped back slightly, eyes half-closed, mouth open in a pleased breathless smile, enjoying it.
panels.ethan_face: Eyes huge, mouth open in a startled little 'o', whole face flushing red, hands up defensively.

dialogue.speaker: luna
dialogue.text: MMM... THERE WE GO. FEELS SO GOOD TO STRETCH OUT.

dialogue.speaker: ethan
dialogue.text: Y-YOU'RE GETTING BIGGER. THAT'S— THAT'S NEW.

panels.notes: Tier 2. First real size change. Clothes strain (L4 — stay on). Ethan small + red.

panels.camera: ecu-face, low-angle-front, beauty close-up, shallow DOF, violet rim light
panels.costume_state: Luna: corset minidress straining, laces tight, hem riding up, fully covering.
panels.action: SOLO LUNA. Glamour beauty shot mid-growth. Her hair lifts and flows on the magic current, eyes glowing violet, black lips parted in a delighted smirk. Candle flames reflected in her eyes. She looks gorgeous and powerful. Implied scale-up (she's at tier 3 now — head brushing toward the beams behind, slightly out of focus).
panels.luna_face: Eyes glowing, half-lidded and sultry, lips parted in a slow confident smile, chin slightly lifted.

dialogue.speaker: luna
dialogue.text: OH, I'M JUST GETTING WARMED UP.

panels.notes: SOLO WOMAN beauty/sexy showcase. Tier 3. Pure glamour beat.

panels.camera: full, low-angle-back, camera low behind and to the right of Luna, over-the-shoulder past her back and down at tiny Ethan craning up
panels.costume_state: Luna: corset minidress seams stretched taut, first small strain tears at seams, still fully covering. Ethan: grey hoodie intact, fully clothed.
panels.action: Luna now towers — tier 4, ~3.5m — filling a third of the loft, one hand on her hip, looking down with a grin. The velvet couch is doll-sized beside her boots. Her dress strains hard at the seams. Down near the bottom corner, tiny Ethan is on the floor, craning his neck up, glasses askew, jaw on the ground, beet-red. Low angle makes Luna look immense and dominant. Luna ~75% of frame. BODY ANGLE: we are BEHIND giant Luna — her back, hair and the back of her strained corset dress and platform boots fill the frame from a low angle; tiny Ethan is seen past her hip/leg, craning his neck up. This is a back/3q-rear orientation (anti-AI variety, L37). Use Luna's turnaround REAR view as reference.
panels.luna_face: Looking down past her cleavage at Ethan, chin tucked, smug satisfied smile, one brow raised, eyes glinting violet.
panels.ethan_face: Head craned all the way back, mouth hanging open, eyes saucer-wide behind crooked glasses, face deep red.

dialogue.speaker: luna
dialogue.text: STILL WITH ME DOWN THERE, SWEETHEART?

dialogue.speaker: ethan
dialogue.text: I, UM. I FORGOT HOW TO BLINK.

notes: WOMAN-FORWARD: panels 3,5,7,9 are SOLO Luna; in shared panels (1,2,4,6,8,10) Luna occupies ~70-80% of the frame and Ethan is the small reaction. 4 solo-her panels + dominant framing in the rest satisfies 'show more of the woman than the guy'.
Monotonic size: tiers go 1,1,1,2,3,4,5,5,6,6 — never decreasing.

Camera: 8 distinct distances (wide-establish, mcu, ecu-region, ecu-face, full, cowboy, splash, medium), mean ~3.0, middle-distance fraction 0.5; 5 distinct angles. Tuned to pass the L20 distance/variety gate while keeping the giantess scale reveals.
Style is photoreal DAZ3D Iray CGI on bodies/room; ONLY the speech bubbles are flat 2D black-and-white comic overlays (L19).
Every character is an ADULT (25). Mandatory adult-only line baked into prompts.
Background = original DAZ3D-style gothic loft built in Flow off a web-sourced DAZ3D interior reference (not a copy).
Funny throughout: running 'party trick' gag, Ethan's deadpan terror one-liners, the snacks line, the planetarium button.

L37 (2026-06-22): body-orientation variety — p06 back/over-shoulder, p07 3q-rear, p08 profile, p09 worm's-eye 3q, p10 over-Ethan's-shoulder (back). Attach character TURNAROUND SHEETS as refs for non-front angles. Avoids the all-face-forward AI tell.
Scale constancy: Ethan + room stay fixed real size in EVERY panel; only Luna grows. p10 scale-fixed (Ethan was rendered shrunk).
